About the Scholarship

EURECOM, based in the Sophia Antipolis technology park near Nice, runs graduate programmes in digital science — AI, cybersecurity, telecommunications and data — plus doctoral studies with its labs and industrial partners. Its admission portal manages both taught-programme rounds and rolling PhD recruitment.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EURECOM, based in the Sophia Antipolis technology park near Nice, runs graduate programmes in digital science — AI, cybersecurity, telecommunications and data — plus doctoral studies with its labs and industrial partners. Its admission portal manages both taught-programme rounds and rolling PhD recruitment.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised digital-science graduate school with strong industry links
  • PhD contracts funded through labs and partner companies
  • Merit tuition waivers for competitive applicants
  • French Riviera location with European tech-ecosystem access

Who Should Apply

Engineering and computer-science graduates targeting AI, security, networking and data specialisations.

Funding and Costs

Merit-based tuition waivers and lab-funded PhD contracts; details per programme on the admission portal. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Create an account on the EURECOM admission portal, choose your programme, and follow the round dates and document checklist shown there. Key deadline information: Rolling PhD admissions; taught-programme rounds close per the admission portal for each intake.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EURECOM

EURECOM is a French graduate school and research centre in digital science, part of the Sophia Antipolis ecosystem, with master's programmes and a doctoral school co-funded by industry partners.

Official website: https://admission.eurecom.fr

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Rolling PhD admissions - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
